These lenticels appear as small white dots distributed along the stem.
- The leaves in the background show some narrowing/distortion, which is also consistent with bacterial canker causing systemic wilt and leaf distortion.
- Powdery mildew could cause white coating on stems but typically presents as a continuous powdery layer, not discrete bumps.
- Sclerotinia would show more cottony white mycelium.
- The discrete, raised white dots on the stem match bacterial canker's raised lenticel symptom very well.
